```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
unlist(first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]])
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August")) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    shape = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) sf::st_polygon(
        map(rings, \(ring) matrix(unlist(ring), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))
      )
    )
  )

largest_fires_sf <- sf::st_sf(
  select(largest_fires, -geometry_coordinates, -shape),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(largest_fires$shape, crs = 4326)
)
bounds <- sf::st_bbox(largest_fires_sf)

leaflet(largest_fires_sf) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap) |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste0(
      incident,
      "<br>Year: ", fire_year,
      "<br>Acres: ", format(gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |>
  fitBounds(
    bounds[["xmin"]],
    bounds[["ymin"]],
    bounds[["xmax"]],
    bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```
